question.text: If sucrolose is <math><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>×</mo><mn>100</mn></math> times of more sweet than Aspartame. What is the value of 'n' here?

solution.text: Aspartame is 100 times more sweet than Sugar while sucrolose is 600 times more sweet than sugar. It means the value of 'n' is 6.
